git.tree: List entries of an exact tree object
git.snapshot: Retain a commit tree and file bytes
stage.remove: Remove a staged file or empty directory
stage.create: Create a staged file from base64 bytes
workflow.find: Find improvement candidates; optional state string filters exact state before the latest-100 limit; omission preserves all states.
skill.find: Find installed skill versions; optional query is a case-insensitive name substring; optional active boolean selects active/inactive versions; omitted filters preserve all versions.
daemon.metrics: Read project model and job counts

input.language: source language, e.g. rust or fluxr

project.semantic_find: Rank retained text passages and paths using Unicode-folded substring matching. Content matches stay within one passage of up to 512 characters. Phrases may be split across passages. Coverage reports eligible, processed and remaining sources.
data.read_query: Run scoped templates: recent_events {template, after?: nonnegative integer cursor, default 0}; request_jobs {template, request: required request ID}. Returns at most 100 rows.

input.due: required nonnegative UTC Unix timestamp in seconds
input.period: required interval in seconds; 0 for one shot
input.action: required object with an allowlisted repeatable project read in tool and its inputs in arguments; omit version for built-ins

connector.call: Read through a registered schema-bound GET connector

connector.write.description: Send the requested write to a registered POST connector from the current chat

input.connector: registered POST connector ID from connector.find
input.arguments: object matching that connector's registered schema

connector.find.description: List active connectors and their fixed argument schemas in this project

repo.pr_propose: Prepare an immutable local pull request proposal
fs.find: Page through paths matching a glob in a retained snapshot
fs.stat: Inspect a project, absolute host, or retained path
tool.find: Search built-in and project tool descriptions
monitor.start: Start a periodic named project read
monitor.status: Inspect monitor id, schedule state, and observation_status (never_sampled, succeeded, error), independently of cancellation.
monitor.stop: Cancel a monitor and revoke its future occurrences
media.read: Return a scoped PNG or JPEG artifact with its exact immutable bytes and recorded media type
tool.promote: Promote a qualified active version using its current default as a precondition
workflow.publish: Publish a qualified correction after reproducing an independent baseline failure
git.fetch: Fetch an approved branch tip into its dedicated remote-tracking ref

git.push.description: Fast-forward the requested registered branch from its observed tip

input.expected: exact advertised object ID from git.remote_refs, or null for an absent branch
input.target: exact local commit object ID to push

git.push_status.description: Check an uncertain push by reading its registered remote branch

input.operation: operation ID from the uncertain git.push receipt

git.remote_list.description: List active registered Git branches for this project

git.remote_refs.description: Read the advertised tip of a registered branch

git.blame: Attribute bounded line ranges to commit IDs in an isolated bare object store
